req.title: Player payload includes squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall include the squadNumber field on every response body under /players/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the squadNumber field must be included in every response body for the /players/{id} endpoint. This ensures that clients can reliably access the squad number of a player, which is a critical piece of information for identifying players within a team. The test suite will verify this requirement by checking for the presence and correctness of the squadNumber field in various scenarios, including valid, invalid, and boundary cases.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_valid
preconditions: Player with id '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802' exists in the database.
expected: Response body contains squadNumber field with value 1.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['squadNumber'] == 1

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_invalid
preconditions: Player with id '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' does not exist in the database.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_boundary
preconditions: Player with id '3a34bd83-441a-4abe-9f6f-210579e1be4b' exists in the database.

tests.executable:
